coverage_issues.message: Failed/unknown outcome does not prove absence of side effects or costs.
Configured trace budget rule 0 observed no applicable completed actions.
Approval policy is enabled but no applicable completed action was observed.
Budget policy is enabled but no completed actions were observed.
Positive assurance requires at least one policy-checked completed action.

limitations: Capture completeness, collector identity, actor identity, human approval and costs are caller declarations, not authenticated facts.
This passive audit inspects already-recorded actions and does not prevent execution or reverse effects.
Recorded dependency edges establish declared lineage, not physical causality or completeness of unobserved activity.
Citations verify recorded source identity and content digests, not semantic entailment, factual truth or licensing.
Integer costs use caller-defined units; this is not billing proof or currency conversion.
Checksums provide integrity, not authenticity, production certification or deployment authorization.
